_comment: Common quests: 3 drawn per session (easy/medium/hard), open to all players, no first-finisher bonus. Guardian quests: personal, given at guardian tiles, always contain a give-back component. Some quests revoke VP if abandoned (revoke_vp). v1 engine tracks these as data; full quest engine is a roadmap item.

easy.name: A Meal Shared
easy.desc: Give any resource to another player.

medium.name: Made to be Given
medium.desc: Craft an item and give it away.

medium.name: Into the Deep
medium.desc: Enter a Tier 2 tile and return with an uncommon resource.

hard.name: The Circle Complete
hard.desc: Make an offering at two different Guardian sites.

hard.name: No One Hungry
hard.desc: In one round, every other player receives a resource from you.

guardian.name: The Grove Asks
guardian.desc: Bring an Offering Bundle to a Guardian. Half its makings must be gathered by another player.

guardian.name: A Promise to Stone
guardian.desc: Return a rare resource to the tile it came from.

guardian.name: Quiet the Waters
guardian.desc: Spend a full turn doing nothing but Rest at Wildwaters. Gain nothing. Notice everything.
